title: Blonde Punk Rocker Girl
description: A stylized female character with voluminous bright yellow hair stands confidently against a solid gray background. She wears a black and yellow punk outfit with cropped jacket displaying 'VITA', fingerless gloves, shorts with garters, and heavy boots, while pointing forward with one hand on her hip.
prompt: A confident young woman with massive, spiky bright yellow hair styled in a wild updo with a black and yellow headband, wearing a black cropped jacket with yellow accents and 'VITA' text on the front, black shorts with yellow straps and buckles, black and yellow combat boots, fingerless mesh gloves, and gold earrings. She stands in a sassy pose with one hand on her hip and the other pointing forward, stylized cartoon illustration with sharp lines and vibrant colors on a plain gray background.
